notes: Nine fresh-process real-raster soaks. Detailed methodology: benchmarks/browser-memory.md.
All values are MiB except navigation, counts and native allocator byte counts.
PSS is proportional process memory; native allocator entries overlap and are not resident totals.
Mobile is emulated with 64 MiB V8 old space and critical pressure, not a physical phone.
Detailed process-by-process samples are emitted by browser:memory:gate and retained in CI artifacts.
Phase 6 frontend soak after capability and Unicode cleanup; no later frontend source changes.
